# Phase 2 Day 1 Closeout

Day 1 covers the local technical baseline: lockfile generation, clean install, typecheck, tests, and build.

## Command

Run from the repository root:

```bash
npm run phase2:day1:closeout
```

This runs the Day 1 capture helper and then validates the generated Day 1 evidence.

## Required generated files

- `package-lock.json`
- `docs/evidence/phase2/day1-lockfile.log`
- `docs/evidence/phase2/day1-npm-ci.log`
- `docs/evidence/phase2/day1-typecheck.log`
- `docs/evidence/phase2/day1-test.log`
- `docs/evidence/phase2/day1-build.log`

## Pass criteria

Day 1 is complete when:

- `package-lock.json` was generated by npm.
- Every Day 1 log exists.
- Every Day 1 log has `## exitCode: 0`.
- `npm run phase2:day1:evidence` exits with code 0.

## Scope boundary

Do not start Day 2 until Day 1 evidence is committed and reviewed.
